request: Update the organization README to explain the automated explorer workflow and show its diagram and VHS demo.
decision: Document the project-history workflow in the organization profile and include only the fictional demo and Pele diagram assets.

why.text: Keep the organization repository guide aligned with the kit workflow.

evidence: The user explicitly requested the organization README update, a VHS README demo and a Pele workflow diagram. Local profile links and GIF header were checked; the same diagram and demo frames were inspected in the kit. No private dataset or raw transcript is included.
alternatives: Link directly to private repository image URLs, which anonymous organization-profile readers cannot load.

verification.scope: Documentation-only repository; no Go program or Go gates apply here.

checks.result: Profile local links resolve; GIF header is valid; copied assets match the visually inspected kit demo and Pele diagram.
